description: Exploratory Stage 2 A/B/C with a fixed v1 Walking Teacher. All groups freeze Decoder and adapt Foot Encoder; A/B are fixed random-Decoder controls, not full-Actor scratch baselines.

teacher.limitations: Only walk1_subject1 assessed; independent Walking holdout and contact/slip qualification remain open. Full-clip Root XY RMSE is 2.3305m.

training_data.goal_source: Procedurally sampled alternating quintic foot trajectories; no MotionLib or LAFAN1 clip is loaded by Stage 2
training_data.teacher_pretraining_clip: LAFAN1 walk1_subject1; inherited through WM/Decoder initialization only

comparison.A: Random WM, random frozen Decoder, new Foot Encoder/Critic/normalization/optimizers/replay
comparison.B: Teacher WM with normalization, random frozen Decoder, new Foot Encoder/Critic/normalization/optimizers/replay
comparison.C: Teacher WM with normalization and Teacher frozen Decoder, new Foot Encoder/Critic/normalization/optimizers/replay
comparison.rule: Finish the same 2000 iterations in every group, including 1000 WM-only and 1000 Actor/Critic iterations. No training wall-clock limit. No adaptive curriculum, Bridge, or upper-body prior.

evaluation.protocol: Serial independent Newton evaluation after each group; physical termination and timeout are separate. Completion alone is not walking success.
